00243 inline float wrap(float in, float lo, float hi) throw()
00244 {
00245     float range;
00246     if (in >= hi) 
00247     {
00248         range = hi - lo;
00249         in -= range;
00250         if (in < hi) return in;
00251     } 
00252     else if (in < lo) 
00253     {
00254         range = hi - lo;
00255         in += range;
00256         if (in >= lo) return in;
00257     } 
00258     else return in;
00259     
00260     if (hi == lo) return lo;
00261     return in - range * std::floor((in - lo)/range); 
00262 }

00291 inline float fold(float in, float lo, float hi) throw() 
00292 {
00293     float x;
00294     float c, range, range2;
00295     x = in - lo;
00296     
00297     if (in >= hi) 
00298     {
00299         in = hi + hi - in;
00300         if (in >= lo) return in;
00301     } 
00302     else if (in < lo) 
00303     {
00304         in = lo + lo - in;
00305         if (in < hi) return in;
00306     } 
00307     else return in;
00308     
00309     if (hi == lo) return lo;
00310 
00311     range = hi - lo;
00312     range2 = range + range;
00313     c = x - range2 * std::floor(x / range2);
00314     if (c>=range) c = range2 - c;
00315     return c + lo;
00316 }

00399 inline float linlin(const float input, 
00400                     const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00401                     const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00402 {
00403     float inRange = inHigh - inLow;
00404     float outRange = outHigh - outLow;
00405     return (input - inLow) * outRange / inRange + outLow;
00406 }

00416 inline float linsin(const float input, 
00417                     const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00418                     const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00419 {
00420     float inRange = inHigh - inLow;
00421     float outRange = outHigh - outLow;
00422         
00423     float inPhase = (input - inLow) * pi / inRange + pi;
00424     float cosInPhase = (float)std::cos((double)inPhase) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00425     
00426     return cosInPhase * outRange + outLow;  
00427 }
00428

00431                      const float outLow, const float outRange) throw()
00432 {

00434     float cosInPhase = (float)std::cos((double)inPhase) * 0.5f + 0.5f;
00435

00440 inline float linexp(const float input, 
00441                     const float inLow, const float inHigh,
00442                     const float outLow, const float outHigh) throw()
00443 {
00444     float outRatio = outHigh / outLow;
00445     float reciprocalInRange = 1.f / (inHigh - inLow);
00446     float negInLowOverInRange = reciprocalInRange * -inLow;
00447     return outLow * pow(outRatio, input * reciprocalInRange + negInLowOverInRange); 
00448 }
00449 
00450 inline float linexp2(const float input, 
00451                      const float reciprocalInRange, const float negInLowOverInRange,
00452                      const float outLow, const float outRatio) throw()
00453 {
00454     return outLow * pow(outRatio, input * reciprocalInRange + negInLowOverInRange); 
00455 }
